name: megascenes-talking-pet-video
description: Make your pet talk: a short video from a photo of your dog, cat or any animal in your MegaScenes library, saying the words you write in a funny or sweet voice.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo of your pet from your MegaScenes library, write what it should say, about 15 words, and choose a voice and what it does: a deep grumpy voice, a squeaky excited voice, a posh accent, while it tilts its head, looks guilty or wags its tail. You get a short video with sound of your pet saying your line, wide or tall for phones and stories.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the video needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For funny posts, birthday messages from the dog, family chats and stories.

Limitations: animals only, never a photo of a person. A clip of about 8 seconds; the voice and the mouth movement are generated with the video, so watch it before sharing. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Your pet says the words you write
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make my dog say: Who ate the cookies? Not me. From my latest MegaScenes photo
My cat complaining about Mondays in a deep grumpy voice
My puppy saying Happy birthday, Anna! in a squeaky excited voice

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make the dog in my latest MegaScenes photo say: Who ate the cookies? Not me. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one talking pet video needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can make a talking pet video here?
positive.expected_behavior: The talking pet video models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make the cat in my latest MegaScenes photo say: Mondays again? Wake me up on Friday. In a deep grumpy voice. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my video on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my video to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
